data.name: Blue Horizons Garden Resort
data.description:
Set in tropical gardens a 3-minute walk from the nearest beach, this laid-back resort is 6 km from Maurice Bishop International Airport, and 7 km from 18th-century Fort George.
Airy studios with balconies come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and kitchenettes; 1-bedroom suites add living rooms with pull-out sofas.
The hotel offers a relaxed Creole restaurant, as well as a bar and grill by an outdoor pool. There's also a library, a kids' play area and gardens.
